title: Too big for the stack
description:
Local variables live on the stack, and the stack is small (about 1 MB here). This program asks for a 16 MB array as a local variable and crashes with a stack overflow before it prints anything. Press Run to see it.

Move the data to the heap by using a `std::vector<int>` of the same size. The vector object itself is tiny; its elements live on the heap. The program should print `7999998`.
hints: `std::vector<int> values(4'000'000);` with round brackets makes four million zeros on the heap.
